summary: Iteration 7 tested all 6 new features. Backend pytest: 7/8 passed. Frontend: all new UI surfaces render with expected data-testids and integrations. Found ONE backend bug: PATCH /api/users silently drops the `deactivation_exempt` field because it is missing from the UserUpdateRequest pydantic model — the checkbox in the UserDrawer appears to save (shows 'Saved.') but the flag never round-trips. This defeats the whole per-user exempt feature.

critical.issue: `deactivation_exempt` is included in the PROFILE_FIELDS allow-list (server.py L806) but NOT declared on the UserUpdateRequest pydantic model (server.py L204-220). Pydantic silently drops it, so the value never reaches the DB. Frontend toggle at [data-testid=user-deactivation-exempt-toggle] therefore never persists. Fix: add `deactivation_exempt: Optional[bool] = None` to UserUpdateRequest AND remove the `v is not None` filter for boolean fields (or use exclude_unset alone) so `False` also persists.

integration_issues.flow: Users → Edit → Profile → toggle Exempt → Save Changes
integration_issues.issue: UI reports 'Saved.' but backend silently discards the field (see backend issue above). GET afterwards shows deactivation_exempt=false.

issues: Same React hydration warning noted in iteration_6 for Payments select is also present here on the ID Card template <select>. Dynamic wrapper injects <span data-ve-dynamic> as child of <option>. Non-fatal but noisy. Occurs from a build-time template tag, not something userland fixes with a single change.

action_items: Add `deactivation_exempt: Optional[bool] = None` to UserUpdateRequest in /app/backend/server.py (around L204). Also ensure the update loop preserves boolean False (the current `v is not None` filter would still allow setting True but block re-setting to False across a rename to `exclude_none`-aware code — verify manually).

The PROFILE_FIELDS/pydantic-model divergence is exactly the kind of bug that motivates single-source-of-truth (pydantic model derives the allow-list, not a hand-typed set).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) auto-username yoshi-userNN backend + frontend placeholder + non-required; (b) auto-deactivate settings GET/PUT/RUN incl. metric validation & days=0 disabled note; (c) permission catalog custom CRUD (create/list/delete, 404 on missing) + built-in hide/unhide with shadow-row creation on PATCH; (d) frontend testids: auto-deactivate-card, custom-perms-card, perm-custom-*, perm-hide/unhide-*, attendance-search-input, attendance-date-from/to, user-deactivation-exempt-toggle, user-tab-idcard; (e) ID Card preview shows 'ISSUED · MAY 29, 2026' rendered from user.created_at via issuedLabel(); (f) full EN/ES tab-cycle regression — no runtime JS errors (only pre-existing hydration warning about <span> in <option>). ONE bug: PATCH /api/users ignores deactivation_exempt. After main agent fixes UserUpdateRequest, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_iteration7.py::TestUserExempt.
rca of the issue: PATCH /api/users deactivation_exempt bug — Pydantic drops unknown fields at request boundary (default extra='ignore'). server.py L204 UserUpdateRequest defines every editable field except deactivation_exempt. When frontend sends {"deactivation_exempt": true}, payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) returns an empty dict for that key, so the field never enters the update loop. The PROFILE_FIELDS allow-list on L802-807 is dead code for this key. Fix: add the field to UserUpdateRequest. Reproduction: `curl -X PATCH .../api/users/<id> -d '{"deactivation_exempt":true}'` → response shows deactivation_exempt=false. Confirmed via pytest test_iteration7.py::TestUserExempt::test_patch_deactivation_exempt (FAILED).
